description:
High-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.

Zed is a next-generation code editor designed for high-performance collaboration with humans and AI.
- Written from scratch in Rust to efficiently leverage multiple CPU cores and your GPU.
- Integrate upcoming LLMs into your workflow to generate, transform, and analyze code.
- Chat with teammates, write notes together, and share your screen and project. All included.
- Zed now speaks WSL. You can open a Linux distro as a first-class “remote” target, edit projects that live inside it.
- All of Zed’s AI features, including edit predictions and ACP-powered agents, are fully supported on Windows.
- All Zed extensions now work seamlessly on Windows; no special steps, no caveats.
- To run on almost all Windows versions, including VMs, we created a new rendering backend based on DirectX 11.
This week's release includes the ability to preview JSONL and NDJSON files as tables.
Features
AI
- Added the agent.max_idle_retained_threads setting to control how many idle agent threads remain loaded. (#64547; thanks hazicy)
- Improved Google AI error messages and added automatic retries when a model was overloaded. (#64865)
- Improved plan updates from ACP agents, including panel refreshes after status changes. (#64884)
- Improved the Agent Panel error shown when a Zed sign-in expired. (#64754)
- Improved visibility of keyboard-selected agent conversations in the Threads Sidebar. (#63922; thanks jaklyk2103)
Git
- Added a folder-specific context menu in the Git Panel's tree view. (#59853; thanks Sondeyy)
Languages
- Added JSONL and NDJSON support to the tabular data preview. Open previews alongside the source with cmd-k v (macOS) or ctrl-k v (Linux/Windows). (#64471; thanks unshDee)
- Added extension installation suggestions for many more languages when opening unsupported files. (#63211; thanks haolamnm)
- Added support for rewrapping text in Typst files. (#64858; thanks AdinAck)
Remote Development
- Added support for terminal.shell in remote sessions. (#61451; thanks quinn)
Other
- Added alt-/ to show the bindings that can complete a pending multi-keystroke shortcut. (#64803)
- Added a soft_wrap_indent setting ("none", "same", "extra_one", "extra_two") to configure indentation for soft-wrapped continuation lines. (#63468; thanks arusahni)
- Improved responsiveness when watching paths on slow or unresponsive filesystems. (#63410; thanks RemcoSmitsDev)
- Improved editor: select next and editor: select previous to respect the buffer search whole-word option. (#64137; thanks yawnnn)
Bug Fixes
- Debugger: Fixed "Rerun last debug scenario" not running the last scheduled scenario. (#64856; thanks MeiramSh)
- Fixed a crash on Windows when reading a stored credential that has no username. (#64735)
- Fixed a crash when pasting multiple selections at the end of a file in Vim mode. (#64876)
- Fixed a crash when typing the start of a multi-key binding at the end of a read-only file. (#64730)
- Fixed agent notifications showing a thread's original title after the thread was renamed. (#64907; thanks IFafaa)
- Fixed commit details and diffs waiting behind an in-progress fetch, pull, or push before opening. (#64720; thanks azeemshaik025)
- Fixed external-agent sessions remaining loaded after their conversation was closed during loading. (#64717)
- Fixed images in Markdown table cells ignoring column alignment and vertical centering. (#64914; thanks dremnik)
- Fixed issues where OpenAI model tool calls to MCP servers treated optional fields as required, causing errors. (#64920)
- Fixed missing or outdated output in agent tool results. (#64708)
- Fixed search highlights in Markdown Preview that hid matched text when the theme used opaque highlight colors. (#64788; thanks IFafaa)
- Fixed stale agent responses that could clear a newer prompt or show errors from an earlier send. (#64917)
- Fixed syntax highlighting for fenced code blocks with extra text after the language name. (#64694; thanks maxmalkin)
- Fixed the pending keybindings list showing task: spawn instead of the task name for bindings that spawn a task. (#64937; thanks frinyvonnick)
- Fixed the Zed Cloud connection failing with UnknownIssuer behind corporate TLS-inspecting proxies whose root CA is installed in the system trust store. (#63686; thanks joepjoosten)
- ACP: Fixed partial tool-call display updates when content referenced an unavailable terminal. (#64784)
- Fixed a bug where inlay hints positioned past the end of a buffer could appear on its last line, and inlay hints exactly at the end of a file without a trailing newline could be hidden. (#64659; thanks HuaGu-Dragon)
- Fixed a rare crash when hovering wrapped Markdown text on Linux. (#64672)
- Fixed centered layout not applying when a pane was zoomed in. (#64064; thanks UdeshyaDhungana)
- Fixed closing one LSP Logs view stopping streams used by another view or downstream client. (#61222; thanks aviatesk)
- Fixed completion details lacking visual distinction from completion labels. (#64684; thanks GautamBytes)
- Fixed delayed selection of the first entry when opening a context menu. (#64365)
- Fixed entries folding when clicked in the Outline Panel. (#64736)
- Fixed Helix buffer picker opening in the wrong pane on space b. (#64494; thanks GautamBytes)
- Fixed hover flicker after dismissing native menus on macOS. (#64175; thanks yay)
- Fixed incorrect selected and hover colors for threads in the Threads Sidebar. (#62597; thanks Robot-Inventor)
- Fixed indentation corruption during multicursor editing and block indentation. (#64675; thanks GautamBytes)
- Fixed language server formatting scrolling to the bottom when the server replaces the entire buffer. (#57269; thanks kalilamodow)
- Fixed row separator lines in tabular data previews extending past the last column. (#63367; thanks HalavicH)
- Fixed soft-wrap continuation line indentation calculation for unindented lines starting at column 0. (#63468; thanks arusahni)
- Fixed terminal tool call output covering the rounded corners of its card in the Agent Panel. (#64328; thanks chrisdrackett)
- Fixed window controls shifting by one pixel when the Threads Sidebar was open on Linux. (#64381; thanks Piyushrathoree)
- Fixed wrap guides showing in the Agent Panel before a conversation started. (#64886; thanks virajbhartiya)
Breaking Changes and Notices
- Changed title-bar application menus on Linux and Windows to require a click before opening. Enable title_bar.open_menus_on_hover to restore opening on hover. (#48496; thanks pauldipietro)
